product_thesis: Graphene is a local-first mission control for bounded multi-agent coding work. Give it one engineering outcome; it validates a dependency-aware work graph, dispatches only policy-allowed isolated work, adapts to bounded failures, assembles accepted artifacts, verifies the result, and creates an isolated local commit only after explicit approval.
primary_user: A solo developer or small technical lead supervising two to five coding agents against one repository.
costly_problem: The developer becomes the scheduler: preventing conflicting edits, relaying context, noticing failures, integrating outputs, and reconstructing whether the result is safe.
result: An exact verified candidate decision and optional isolated local commit with V2 publication evidence, a registered immutable pre-decision bundle, explicit resource semantics, and unresolved unknowns. Bounded ADK workers, collision-safe tree hashing, cold integrity verification, revision/invalidation, and a partial authoritative Firestore/outbound-executor vertical are credential-free tested; external proof remains separate.

working_tree_integrity.sqlite: The v2 store persists immutable canonical record bytes and verifies a schema-ledger digest before use.
working_tree_integrity.recovery: Recovered dispatches are selected from a bounded explicit worker-owner set and attempt/lease ownership must agree.
working_tree_integrity.workspace_audit: The generic ADK WorkerRuntime uses a bounded Git workspace auditor to independently measure base/admin identity, path and mode changes, and a content-addressed patch before publication; the separate scripted fixture does not inherit this claim.
working_tree_integrity.tree_hash: graphene.tree.v2 length-prefixes count, path, mode/type, and content; the exact former NUL encoding collision and an independent reference encoder are covered locally.
working_tree_integrity.trusted_checks: Only check.completed from the check-runner authority can bind deterministic success to the exact attempt/fence, plan/policy, inputs, template, candidate tree, and result.
working_tree_integrity.task_input: A gate-scoped needs_input task resumes only after 1–4096 private UTF-8 bytes are stored and their exact artifact reference is committed through graphene task input. The browser seam is tested but hidden in one-command live mode because staged-input cleanup is not wired.
working_tree_integrity.hard_budgets: Attempt, worker-time, and artifact exhaustion commit blocked_budget, pause dispatch, and name replan_or_cancel; ordinary resume does not clear the task blocker.
working_tree_integrity.component_limits: Successful publications require ArtifactEnvelopeV2, and the exact pending FinalResultBundleV2 is registered before Mission Control display and bundle-ID-bound approval/rejection. Causal query and sampled resource control have targeted local tests; transitive artifact subsumption and live operator proof remain open.

terminal_surface.limit: The pending bundle is prepared before the decision; display, approval, rejection, recovery, create-only export, and verification bind its exact ID.
